title: console-tooling-standup-2026-04-07
body:
Date: 2026-04-07
Attendees: Maya Patel (owner), Daniel Kim, Priya Singh, Tom Alvarez, Sarah Ng

Summary: Quick sync for console & tooling (UI, rollouts, analytics). Focus this week on stabilizing rollout canary, finishing model-route editor UX polish, and addressing cost aggregation quirks in analytics dashboards. Notes below are informal; parking-lot items added.

Updates by area:
- UI / Console:
  - Model route editor: PR #1284 merged to main (frontend + validation layer). UX tweaks remain: inline validation messages for function/tool calling and better empty-state for KV cache options. Daniel to run accessibility pass on 2026-04-08.
  - Save behavior: intermittent 500 when saving rollout config observed in prod-canary. Repro steps captured, ticket FE-541 opened. Investigation shows a race in the rollout service when creating a new policy + immediate attach to route.
  - Work left: wire up undo for rollout edits (low priority) and add a telemetry event for "save_rollout_attempt".

- Rollouts / Backend:
  - Canary rollout for model-routing v2 started at 10% in us-west2 (ROLL-219). Early metrics: stable error rate, but 2% increase in p95 latency for cold-starts. Disabled aggressive prewarming; will re-evaluate tomorrow.
  - Fallback policy tested and validated for mixed-variant fallbacks; no incidents so far.
  - Next: expand canary to 25% on 2026-04-09 if no regressions. Post-canary review scheduled for 2026-04-14.

- Analytics / Observability:
  - Per-route token-cost dashboard shipped to staging. Noted discrepancy: cost aggregation job double-counts tokens for retried requests causing inflated daily totals (ENG-867). Root cause appears in the dedupe logic when retry_id is null.
  - Action: Tom to push a fix to the aggregator (+ unit tests) by EOD 2026-04-08. Add e2e synthetic to nightlies to catch regressions.
  - Traces: added a tracing tag for "route.save.duration" to correlate frontend saves with backend latency spikes.

Blockers / Risks:
- CI creds expired for integration tests causing nightly regressions (CI-402). Priya to coordinate with SRE for rotation; target window 2026-04-08 09:00-10:00 PT.
- FE-541 (save 500) blocks full rollout of v2 for customers using programmatic APIs; priority set to P1. Need backend owner to pair for repro and fix.

Action items:
- Tom Alvarez: implement dedupe fix in cost aggregator and open PR; aim to merge by EOD 2026-04-08. (ENG-867)
- Priya Singh: coordinate credential rotation with SRE and verify nightlies pass after rotation on 2026-04-08 morning. (CI-402)
- Maya Patel: prioritize FE-541 in sprint board, pair with Daniel on reproduction steps and escalate to backend if repro requires schema change.
- Daniel Kim: accessibility pass on model route editor and address inline validation UX on 2026-04-08.
- Sarah Ng: add synthetic test for route-save to nightly E2E suite and validate trace tags for route.save.duration.

Parking lot / follow-ups:
- Evaluate prewarm strategies if cold-start latency persists after canary expansion.
- Discuss adding a small chargeback experiment to feature flags to measure cost sensitivity per customer.
- Consider a canary rollback playbook doc for next on-call rotation.

Next meeting: 2026-04-14 for post-canary review (tentative)

Quick links: Confluence (rollouts overview) and Jira tickets above; GH PRs for UI and infra referenced in linked_artifacts.

Notes: informal - will tidy up into a confluence summary if needed after post-canary review.
